mapper.insert: INSERT INTO summary ( counseling_result_id, user_id, status, is_bookmarked, created_at ) VALUES ( #{counselingResultId}, #{userId}, 'LOADING', false, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE summary SET title = #{title}, subject = #{subject}, keywords = CAST(#{keywords} AS JSON), points = CAST(#{points} AS JSON) WHERE summary_id = #{summaryId}
mapper.select: SELECT summary_id AS summaryId, counseling_result_id AS counselingResultId, user_id AS userId, title, subject, keywords, points, is_bookmarked AS isBookmarked, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM summary WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT summary_id AS summaryId, counseling_result_id AS counselingResultId, user_id AS userId, title, subject, keywords, points, is_bookmarked AS isBookmarked, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM summary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_bookmarked = true ORDER BY created_at DESC
